2066-wildfire.creator: Zane Grey
2066-wildfire.description: A book by Zane Grey. She had no desire for civilization, she flouted the idea of marrying the rich rancher of Durango. arxiv-2010-07265.title: Eigenstate entanglement scaling for critical interacting spin chains
arxiv-2010-07265.creator: Qiang Miao, Thomas Barthel
arxiv-2010-07265.description: Abstract With increasing subsystem size and energy, bipartite entanglement entropies of energy eigenstates cross over from the groundstate scaling to a volume law. In previous work, we pointed out that, when strong or weak eigenstate thermalization (ETH) applies, the entanglement entropies of all or, respectively, almost all eigenstates follow a single crossover function.

arxiv-2305-05262.title: Two-qubit operations for finite-energy Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill encodings
arxiv-2305-05262.creator: Ivan Rojkov, Paul Moser Röggla, Martin Wagener, Moritz Fontboté-Schmidt, Stephan Welte, Jonathan Home, Florentin Reiter
arxiv-2305-05262.description: Abstract We present techniques for performing two-qubit gates on Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) codes with finite energy, and find that operations designed for ideal infinite-energy codes create undesired entanglement when applied to physically realistic states. We demonstrate that this can be mitigated using recently developed local error-correction protocols, and evaluate the resulting performance.

arxiv-2312-17702.title: Anisotropy-driven topological quantum phase transition in magnetic impurities
arxiv-2312-17702.creator: A. A. Aligia
arxiv-2312-17702.description: Abstract A few years ago, a topological quantum phase transition (TQPT) has been found in Anderson and Kondo 2-channel spin-1 impurity models that include a hard-axis anisotropy term D ​ S z 2 DS_{z}^{2} with D > 0 D>0 .

arxiv-2401-13257.title: Diverse Science from VLT imagery and spectroscopy of PNe in the Galactic Bulge
arxiv-2401-13257.creator: Quentin Parker 1, Shuyu Tan 1, Andreas Ritter 1, Albert Zijlstra 2
arxiv-2401-13257.description: Abstract We have undertaken a deep investigation of a well defined sample of 136 PNe located in a 10 × 10 10\times 10 degree central region of the Galactic Bulge observed with the ESO VLT and supplemented by archival HST imagery.

arxiv-2502-17956.title: Towards Better Understanding of Program-of-Thought Reasoning in Cross-Lingual and Multilingual Environments
arxiv-2502-17956.creator: Patomporn Payoungkhamdee, Pume Tuchinda, Jinheon Baek, Samuel Cahyawijaya, Can Udomcharoenchaikit, Potsawee Manakul, Peerat Limkonchotiwat, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich, Sarana Nutanong
arxiv-2502-17956.description: Abstract Multi-step reasoning is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet multilingual performance remains challenging. While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning, it struggles with non-English languages due to the entanglement of reasoning and execution. Program-of-Thought (PoT) prompting separates reasoning from execution, offering a promising alternative but shifting the challenge to generating programs from non-English questions.

arxiv-2505-15698.title: An Efficient Data Structure and Algorithm for Long-Match Query in Run-Length Compressed BWT
arxiv-2505-15698.creator: Ahsan Sanaullah, Degui Zhi, Shaojie Zhang
arxiv-2505-15698.description: Abstract String matching problems in bioinformatics are typically for finding exact substring matches between a query and a reference text. Previous formulations often focus on maximum exact matches (MEMs). However, multiple occurrences of substrings of the query in the text that are long enough but not maximal may not be captured by MEMs.

pmc-11387374.title: Impact of multiple comorbidities on long-term mortality in older patients following transcatheter aortic valve replacement
pmc-11387374.creator: Satoshi Higuchi, Hidenari Matsumoto, Ryota Masaki, Seita Kondo, Yasuhide Mochizuki, Shiori Fuse, Eiji Toyosaki, Tomoaki Masuda, Kazuto Maruta, Tadashi Omoto, Atsushi Aoki, Toshiro Shinke
pmc-11387374.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundOlder candidates for transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) frequently present with both cardiac and noncardiac comorbidities. There are few risk scores that evaluate a wide range of comorbidities.MethodsPatients who underwent TAVR for severe aortic stenosis were retrospectively evaluated. A new prediction model (Cardiac and nonCardiac Comorbidities risk score: 3C score) was determined based on coefficient in the multivariate Cox regression analysis for two-year all-cause mortality.

pmc-11488222.title: The association between maternal anemia and neonatal anemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11488222.creator: Bokang Zhao, Mengxing Sun, Tianchen Wu, Jiaxin Li, Huifeng Shi, Yuan Wei
pmc-11488222.description: ImportanceNeonatal anemia has a long-term effect on children's growth and development. Anemia during pregnancy is also the most widespread nutritional deficiency among pregnant women in the world; If it leads to anemia in newborns, it will affect a wide range of people and be a public health problem worthy of attention.

pmc-11489074.title: A rare cause of dyspnea on exertion with a cardiopulmonary exercise stress test☆
pmc-11489074.creator: Elizabeth H. Lees, Hernan Cardozo Torres, Eric S. Edell, Gustavo Cortes Puentes, Thomas A. Foley, Janani S. Reisenauer, Thomas G. Allison
pmc-11489074.description: Informative abstractBackgroundIt is rare for an adult patient to be living decades after a pneumonectomy procedure. This case features complications that can arise. We utilize cardiopulmonary exercise stress testing (CPET) to highlight long-term physiologic changes that can present in a post-pneumonectomy patient.

pmc-12514388.title: MonoPER study: Effectiveness and tolerability of PERampanel in monotherapy in real‐world after 12 months of treatment
pmc-12514388.creator: Alejandro Fernández‐Cabrera, Paula Santamaría‐Montero, Jesús García de‐Soto, Robustiano Pego‐Reigosa
pmc-12514388.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveTo evaluate the effectiveness, tolerability, and retention of PER as monotherapy in adults with focal or idiopathic generalized epilepsy over a 12‐month period in routine clinical practice.MethodsIn this single‐center, ambispective, noninterventional observational study, 74 patients (age 18–90 years) initiated PER monotherapy—either as first‐line treatment (n = 21) or conversion from another antiseizure medication (n = 53)—and were followed for 12 months.

pmc-12845226.title: Trypanocidal Activity of Dual Redox-Active Quinones: Trypanosoma cruzi Mitochondrion as a Target Organelle In Vitro and Anti-Inflammatory Properties In Vivo
pmc-12845226.creator: Raquel B. Duarte, Victor F. S. Ramos, Juliana M. C. Barbosa, Gabriel M. Oliveira, Emilay B. T. Diogo, Renata G. Almeida, Alastair J. J. Lennox, Eufrânio N. da Silva Júnior, Yasmin Pedra-Rezende, Rubem F. S. Menna-Barreto
pmc-12845226.description: Chagas disease is caused by the protozoan Trypanosoma cruzi, and its current treatment is limited to the use of two nitroderivatives, benznidazole (Bz) and nifurtimox; however, their toxicity often leads to discontinuation, justifying the search for new therapeutic options. The biological activity of quinones has long shown efficacy towards pathogenic microorganisms.

pmc-13522454.title: A brain-health framework for PTSD: integrating digital biomarkers into multimodal assessment
pmc-13522454.creator: Edel McGlanaghy, Dylan Powell, Tony Robertson
pmc-13522454.description: We propose a novel framework and measurement model that frames post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in the context of brain health capital, utilising advances in smart devices (wearables, phones) and AI to better capture the multimodal physiological, behavioural, and cognitive features of PTSD.

pmc-13549329.title: GoniOwl: convolutional neural network-based sample state detection for collision prevention on synchrotron beamlines
pmc-13549329.creator: Christian M. Orr, James O’Hea, Armin Wagner
pmc-13549329.description: GoniOwl, a lightweight convolutional neural network integrated into the EPICS control system, detects sample-pin presence from beamline camera images with >99% accuracy and fail-safe uncertainty handling, offering a transferable approach to vision-based collision prevention on synchrotron beamlines. Introduction Synchrotron beamlines are complex experimental environments where precise mechanical coordination is essential (Rees et al., 2007 ▸).
